titulo_es: Priorities under pressure · Welfare, access and priorities

texto: In public service proposals it distinguishes objective, measure, target population and funding. A budget figure describes an estimated cost; it does not itself decide whether the measure is effective.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
